hook: Cyberabad Corporation's new HQ: *₹169 crore*, twin towers, net-zero
hook_b: Cyberabad Corporation's new HQ: *₹169 crore*, twin towers, net-zero
tldr: The new Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC) floated e-tenders on Wednesday for its permanent headquarters at Izzath Nagar, Serilingampally mandal.

beats.what: Two interconnected towers, G 6 and G 8, with 2,41,540 sq ft of built-up area.
beats.why: The CMC needs a permanent home for its present and future administrative work.
beats.care: It will hold citizen service centres, a Prajavani grievance hall and an integrated command centre.

causes.label: New Cyberabad corporation needs an office

effects.label: Citizen service centres in one place

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Renewable energy, wastewater recycling, smart building management and climate-responsive design are planned to make it net-zero.

cards.q: Would you go to a corporation office in person for a complaint?

facts.t: The HQ site is *4.11 acres* adjoining Kotha Kunta Lake.

steps.e: 4.11 acres, Izzath Nagar, by Kotha Kunta Lake

viz.verdict: A permanent office for the new Cyberabad corporation; construction timeline not given yet.
